register.labelZh: SMOOTH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: smooth away 和 smooth out 可以描述如何減少小困難、憂慮或突然變化,令事情進行得更順利。；smooth down 可以自然地描述把頭髮、衣物、床罩或翹起的邊位壓平整理。；smooth out 可以描述把信紙、地圖、恤衫或桌布的摺痕和皺摺弄平。；smooth over 可以描述透過道歉、解釋或交談,令爭執或誤會不再那麼嚴重。
register.summaryEn: Smooth away and smooth out help you describe how small difficulties, worries or sudden changes are reduced so that something works more easily. Smooth down gives you a natural way to describe pressing hair, clothes, covers or loose edges flat and tidy. Smooth out can describe making a letter, map, shirt or tablecloth flat again by removing folds and wrinkles. Smooth over helps you describe an apology, explanation or conversation that makes a disagreement or misunderstanding less serious.
